claims.sentence: Each lane report records its own source hash, semantics-specific oracle hash, and status counts; a lane passes only with zero wrong, failed, and unsupported rows, while timeout or unavailable oracle evidence blocks the lane.
The accepted SPACL query verdict (lane gate passed, 60/60 oracle matches accepted)
Its published claims are execution performance and completability only: per-engine times, timeouts, and completed-run counts on the pinned corpus.
ORE rows keep `oracle_unavailable` as their permanent, honest correctness status.
The primary timing statistic is the per-case median container-inclusive wall time across the three passes; engine-reported times stay secondary diagnostics.
The sweep is a performance lane under the ADR 0024 terms: execution performance and completability claims only, no correctness claims — no oracle exists for OWL2Bench consistency.
